mapper.select: SELECT MYDATA_ID AS mydataId, USER_ID AS userId, PROVIDER AS provider, REFRESH_TOKEN_ENCRYPTED AS refreshTokenEncrypted, REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT AS refreshTokenExpiresAt, MYDATA_STATUS AS mydataStatus, LAST_SYNCED_AT AS lastSyncedAt FROM `MYDATA` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PROVIDER = #{provider}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `MYDATA` ( USER_ID, PROVIDER, REFRESH_TOKEN_ENCRYPTED, REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT, MYDATA_STATUS, LAST_SYNCED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{provider}, #{refreshTokenEncrypted}, #{refreshTokenExpiresAt}, #{mydataStatus}, #{lastSyncedAt} )
